definitions.explanation: A reference back to something that has already been written or described earlier in the same document or discussion.

examples.japanese: {既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
{既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is rejected for the reasons already stated.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{論|ろん}じた→論ずる：28402_ronzuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since this issue was discussed in detail in the previous chapter, it will be omitted here.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{既|き}→既〜：28657_ki⟧ (already) and {述|じゅつ} (to state, to describe). A formal written-language word used to refer back to earlier content in reports, papers, and official documents. Rarely used in spoken Japanese.

USAGE:
Almost exclusively a written-language word. Commonly appears as {既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (the aforementioned) or {既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり (as previously stated).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり — as previously stated
- {既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ — the previously described content
- {既述|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧ — the reasons already stated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前述|ぜんじゅつ}→前述：11911_zenjutsu⟧ — aforementioned; very similar in meaning but ⟦{前述|ぜんじゅつ}→前述：11911_zenjutsu⟧ emphasizes sequence (what came before), while {既述|きじゅつ} emphasizes that it has already been done
- ⟦{記述|きじゅつ}→記述：05819_kijutsu⟧ — description, statement; a homophone with a different meaning — the act of writing or describing, rather than a reference to prior content
